title: test/e2e: fix podman run with noexec for ubuntu 26.04
body:
Test case bind mounts host's /bin to /hostbin and tries to exec /hostbin/ls, and expects a particular exit code.

It does not work on Ubuntu 26.04 because it ships with coreutils-rs by default, in which:

	/bin/ls -> ../lib/cargo/bin/coreutils/ls

and so we get ENOENT instead of EPERM.

Fix by replacing ls with true. The funny thing is, it's also a symlink on Ubuntu 26.04:

	/bin/true -> gnutrue

but it works since the destination is in the same directory.

(NOTE the whole test relies on the fact that the kernel checks permissions first -- a dynamic binary from a different distro won't be able to run anyway.)

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

NONE
